The '''Tower Ridge Water Silo''' was one of the first [[Water/Legends|water]] storage facilities built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Built on [[Tower Ridge]] near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], the structure consisted of a square metal building with an oval silo sitting on top. Entrance into the silo was provided by a set of double doors, and a control box was attached to a side wall.<ref name="TM" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the water silo was used by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Slag Flats]]. During the [[Escape from Tatooine|hunt]] for [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], Flats was killed by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by [[Jodo Kast]]. A team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s were due to met with Flats and found her corpse, and were subsequently trapped in the water silo by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Quist]]. The Alliance team managed to escape from the silo.<ref name="TM" />
